problem.title: Vehicle history is scattered
points: Receipts, photos, chats, and memory — a vehicle's history lives in too many places.
Buyers need more context than a listing can give.
Sellers need a clean way to show what is actually documented.

passport.title: The Vehicle Passport
passport.lead: A shareable snapshot of the vehicle history you choose to include.
points: Shows what is documented, what is missing, and what was shared.
Includes a Record Confidence Score that reflects documentation quality.
A buyer can preview it before deciding.
A buyer can accept it to copy the shared history into their account.
disclaimers: A tamper-evident snapshot — not an official ownership document.
Not a mechanical certification or a guarantee of condition.
Record Confidence measures documentation quality, not the vehicle's condition.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.intro: How Vin.ID handles your data during the beta.
points: Vin.ID stores the vehicle data you provide (vehicles, maintenance, issues, documents, reminders).
Documents you upload may contain personal information. Review them carefully before sharing.
Vehicle Passport sharing is controlled by you — only the data you choose is included.
Public Passport links expose only the selected snapshot data, not your account or raw files.
Documents are private by default and are shared only if you explicitly allow it.
AI-style features run in mock mode (not real AI analysis) while MOCK_AI is enabled.

We log minimal product events during the beta (e.g. that a vehicle or Passport was created) to understand usage. These never include document contents, issue symptoms, diagnosis text, VIN, license plate, storage paths, or raw Passport tokens, and we do not use any third-party analytics provider.

You can export your account data and vehicle history from Settings (JSON and CSV). Exports do not include your original uploaded document files, and may contain sensitive information — keep them private.
Automated account deletion is not enabled during the beta. You can request deletion from Settings and we will handle it manually; full self-service automation may come later.

Document scanning is optional. When you scan a document, its image is sent to a third-party AI provider (Anthropic) for extraction, and the original image is saved to your private vehicle documents (private by default) and linked to the record you confirm so you can open it later.

invitations.title: Pending invitations
invitations.confirmRevokeBody: The link sent to {email} will stop working immediately.

errors.notAuthorized: You do not have permission to do this.
errors.alreadyMember: That person is already a member of this organization.
errors.duplicatePending: There is already a pending invitation for that address. Revoke it first to send a new one.
errors.linkUnavailable: The invitation link could not be generated because the app URL is not configured.
errors.lastOwner: This organization must keep at least one owner. Promote someone else to owner first.
errors.cannotManageOwner: Only an owner can change or remove another owner.
errors.copyFailed: Couldn't copy automatically. Select the link and copy it manually.
errors.saveFailed: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.personalWorkspace: Personal workspaces can't have members. Create a separate organization first.

activation.title: Organization management
activation.description: Managing vehicles for a business or team? Create a separate organization workspace and invite members.
activation.personalNote: Your personal vehicles and records will remain in your Personal workspace.

errors.noProfile: Your account isn't fully set up yet. Reload and try again.
errors.saveFailed: Something went wrong. Please try again.

invite.heading: You've been invited to {organization}
invite.signInPrompt: Sign in or create an account to accept it.
invite.switchAccount: Sign in with a different account

success.title: You're in.
success.body: You now have access to this organization's fleet.

invalid.title: This invitation link isn't valid
invalid.body: Check that you copied the whole link, or ask for a new invitation.

expired.title: This invitation has expired
expired.body: Invitation links are valid for 7 days. Ask for a new one.

revoked.title: This invitation was revoked
revoked.body: Ask an owner or admin of the organization to send a new one.

accepted.title: This invitation was already used
accepted.body: If that was you, just sign in. Otherwise ask for a new invitation.

email_mismatch.title: This invitation is for a different email address
email_mismatch.body: Sign in with the address the invitation was sent to, then open the link again.

not_authenticated.title: You need to sign in first
not_authenticated.body: Sign in with the invited email address, then open the link again.

already_member.title: You already belong to another organization
already_member.body: An account can be in one organization at a time. Ask to be removed from your current one first.

failed.title: Something went wrong
failed.body: The invitation could not be accepted. Please try again.

noAssignment.title: No vehicle assigned yet
noAssignment.body: Once your fleet manager assigns you a vehicle, its details, service history and shared documents appear here.

documents.title: Shared documents
documents.empty: Your fleet manager has not shared any documents for this vehicle.

assignment.title: Assigned driver
assignment.none: No driver is assigned to this vehicle.
assignment.noEligibleDrivers: No one in this organization holds the driver role yet. Invite a driver from the Organization screen first.
assignment.noteHelp: Visible to managers only — the driver never sees this note.
assignment.willMove: This driver is currently assigned to another vehicle. Assigning them here will end that assignment.

errors.notAuthorized: You do not have permission to change driver assignments.
errors.vehicleNotFound: That vehicle is no longer available.
errors.memberNotFound: That member is no longer in this organization.
errors.notADriver: Only members with the driver role can be assigned a vehicle.
errors.saveFailed: Could not save the assignment. Please try again.

workspace.title: Workspace
workspace.help: Your personal vehicles and any organizations you belong to. Switching changes what you see — it never changes who owns anything.

errors.notAMember: You are no longer a member of that workspace.
errors.failed: Could not switch workspace. Try again.
